_comment: Findings reviewed one at a time and accepted, with the reason each is not a defect.
The gate fails on anything NOT listed here, and on a count higher than the one recorded,
so this can only shrink. It is not a list of rules to ignore: the same rule in a new file,
or one more occurrence in a file already listed, is a failure.
